title: OTel Collector Ingest
description: What the collector writes to ClickHouse: volume per signal and service, storage.

panels.title: Spans / s
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, count() / $__interval_s AS spans
FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Logs / s
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, count() / $__interval_s AS logs
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Metric points / s
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, count() / $__interval_s AS points
FROM (SELECT 'spans' AS signal, ServiceName, Timestamp AS ts FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'logs', ServiceName, Timestamp FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)) WHERE signal = 'metric points'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Reporting services
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, uniqExact(ServiceName) AS services
FROM (SELECT 'spans' AS signal, ServiceName, Timestamp AS ts FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'logs', ServiceName, Timestamp FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)) WHERE ServiceName != ''
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ingest rate by signal
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, signal, count() / $__interval_s AS rate
FROM (SELECT 'spans' AS signal, ServiceName, Timestamp AS ts FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'logs', ServiceName, Timestamp FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))
GROUP BY time, signal ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ingest rate by service
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, if(ServiceName = '', 'collector (host)', ServiceName) AS service,
  count() / $__interval_s AS rate
FROM (SELECT 'spans' AS signal, ServiceName, Timestamp AS ts FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'logs', ServiceName, Timestamp FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))
GROUP BY time, service ORDER BY time

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Telemetry each service sent in the selected range
panels.sql:
SELECT if(ServiceName = '', 'collector (host)', ServiceName) AS service,
  countIf(signal = 'spans') AS spans,
  countIf(signal = 'logs') AS logs,
  countIf(signal = 'metric points') AS metric_points,
  max(ts) AS last_seen
FROM (SELECT 'spans' AS signal, ServiceName, Timestamp AS ts FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'logs', ServiceName, Timestamp FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'metric points', ServiceName, TimeUnix FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix))
GROUP BY service ORDER BY last_seen DESC

panels.title: Spans by SDK language
panels.sql:
SELECT ResourceAttributes['telemetry.sdk.language'] AS language, count() AS spans
FROM otel_traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND language != ''
GROUP BY language ORDER BY spans DESC

panels.title: Storage per table
panels.description: Active parts of the otel_* tables, independent of the time range
panels.sql:
SELECT table, sum(rows) AS rows,
  formatReadableSize(sum(data_compressed_bytes)) AS compressed,
  formatReadableSize(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes)) AS uncompressed,
  round(sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) / greatest(sum(data_compressed_bytes), 1), 1) AS ratio
FROM system.parts
WHERE active AND database = currentDatabase() AND table LIKE 'otel\_%'
GROUP BY table ORDER BY sum(data_compressed_bytes) DESC

panels.title: Compressed size per table
panels.sql:
SELECT table, sum(data_compressed_bytes) AS bytes
FROM system.parts
WHERE active AND database = currentDatabase() AND table LIKE 'otel\_%'
GROUP BY table ORDER BY bytes DESC
